# Resource inventory

Everything that existed in the lab project on 2026-11-18, from `gcloud` and `kubectl`
listings taken while the cluster was running. Identifiers are replaced with placeholders.

**Created by:** TF = Terraform (`terraform/`) · GKE = generated by GKE from cluster or
Gateway config · CB = the Cloud Build import · CLI = `gcloud` by hand ·
AUTO = created by Google Cloud by default.

## Project and billing

| Resource | Details | Created by |
|---|---|---|
| Project `<PROJECT_ID>` | dedicated lab project | CLI |
| Budget "gke-llm-lab budget" | $20, alerts at 25 / 50 / 100% | CLI |

No Compute Engine VMs other than GKE nodes; no Cloud Run services (API not enabled).

## Network

| Resource | Details | Created by |
|---|---|---|
| VPC `llm-vpc` | custom mode, regional routing | TF |
| Subnet `gke-nodes` | `10.10.0.0/20`, Private Google Access on; secondary `pods` `10.20.0.0/16`, `services` `10.30.0.0/20` | TF |
| Cloud Router / Cloud NAT | **none** (deliberate) | – |
| Firewall `gke-llm-cluster-…-all` | ingress from pod range `10.20.0.0/16` to nodes | GKE |
| Firewall `gke-llm-cluster-…-vms` | ingress from node range `10.10.0.0/20` to nodes | GKE |
| Firewall `gkegw1-…-l7-llm-vpc-global` | ingress tcp from `130.211.0.0/22`, `35.191.0.0/16` (Google LB / health checks) | GKE |
| VPC `default` + 4 firewall rules | **allows SSH (22) and RDP (3389) from `0.0.0.0/0`**; not used by the lab | AUTO |

## GKE

| Resource | Details | Created by |
|---|---|---|
| Cluster `llm-cluster` | Standard, zonal us-central1-a, 1.36.4-gke, REGULAR channel, private nodes, master authorized networks `<AUTHORIZED_IP>/32`, Workload Identity, Gateway API, GCS FUSE CSI, Managed Prometheus, cost allocation | TF |
| Node pool `cpu-inference` | spot `e2-standard-4`, 50 GB pd-balanced, autoscaling 1–4, Shielded VMs, SA `gke-nodes` | TF |
| Nodes | 2 at the time of listing, internal IPs only, no external IPs | GKE |

### Kubernetes objects (namespace `llm`, Pod Security `restricted`)

| Object | Details |
|---|---|
| Deployment `llm-server` | 2 replicas, llama-server + `gke-gcsfuse-sidecar` (native sidecar), image by digest |
| Service `llm-server` | ClusterIP :80 → 8080 |
| HorizontalPodAutoscaler `llm-server` | CPU 60%, bounds from `deploy.sh` (2–6 by default; 2–2 during rollout tests) |
| PodDisruptionBudget `llm-server` | `minAvailable: 1` |
| ServiceAccount `llm-server` | Workload Identity principal for the bucket; token automount off |
| Gateway `llm-gateway` | class `gke-l7-global-external-managed`, HTTP :80 |
| HTTPRoute `llm-route` | `/v1/*`, `/health` → `llm-server:80` |
| HealthCheckPolicy / GCPBackendPolicy `llm-server` | `/health:8080`; timeout 120s, draining 45s |
| ConfigMap `k6-scripts` | k6 test script |
| Jobs `k6-*` | load-test runs (TTL 1h) |
